hooks.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "DOCUMENTATION REMINDER: If this turn involved any architecture discussion, design decision, implementation plan, or feature analysis — track the full thread (analysis, discussion, questions raised, and final decision) in a new MD file in documentation/md/ (named by topic, e.g. PARTNER_FINDING_DESIGN.md). The file should capture the reasoning journey from initial analysis to final decision, not just the conclusion. Also add a summary of the key points to the relevant section of PROGRESS.md."}'
